summary: Runtime membership reads only the newest actual status fields it needs instead of eagerly folding every candidate's complete observation history. Full card reductions retain their existing actual-state and source-selection folds.

replay.detail: No replay, backfill or retained claim change.

schema.detail: No schema, projection version, checkpoint or digest change.

rules.detail: Membership uses the existing single-subject field reader, including owner status/mode and reserved-kind exclusion; declarations and lifecycle rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client or peer wire change. Membership answers match the single-subject reference; full visible cards still fold their complete actual state.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no coordinated restart or service interruption is required.

manual.detail: No manual steps or feature activation.

recovery.detail: Revert the change to restore eager membership folding; no stored state requires conversion.
